text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a common practice in modern software development. Developers often work on the same project, so they need to combine their changes regularly. With CI, every time someone adds new code, an automated build starts immediately. The system also runs tests to check that everything works correctly. This helps teams catch issues early, before they become big problems. A CI pipeline usually includes several steps, such as building the code, running tests, and reporting results. By using CI pipelines, teams can save time, improve code quality, and release software more safely and quickly.
